title: Pune-based supply chain robotics startup Unbox Robotics raised a $28M Series B in a mix of primary and secondary capital, after raising $15M in earlier rounds (Anjali Jain/Inc42 Media)
summary: Anjali Jain / Inc42 Media: Pune-based supply chain robotics startup Unbox Robotics raised a $28M Series B in a mix of primary and secondary capital, after raising $15M in earlier rounds — SUMMARY — The round was a mix of primary and secondary capital, with employees getting liquidity through the ESOP programme
